description: This Java class defines a mock implementation of a legacy door/window security cluster, extending security functionalities and incorporating capabilities such as tamper detection, fault status, low battery indication, and trouble status. It also includes methods for toggling states and handling manufacturer-specific commands.

classes.name: MockLegacyDoorWindowCluster
classes.description: A mock class simulating a legacy door/window security device cluster with capabilities for tampering, fault detection, low battery, and trouble status, including methods for toggling states and handling manufacturer commands.

methods.name: isTroubled

methods.description: Returns a byte array indicating current status flags such as tamper, alarm, low battery, and trouble.
